item.title: Add Some Style to Your JavaScript Log
item.description:
Did you know that console.log can render styled text? Colors, drop shadows, custom fonts – all in your browser’s developer console. This post shows you how it is done and what it looks like across browsers.

Skip to the how-to

Backstory

Anytime I want to show off what the web can do with a simple blog I have to pull up this awesome site. I was on A Very Cool Site about Hackery, Math & Design, and the question was asked “how did he do that?”
